intro: This Product User Manual details the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Protected Areas (PA) product, offering harmonised land cover and land use information for over 25,000 Natura 2000 sites across Europe. It outlines the product's evolution, including the 2021 status layer, which establishes a new baseline with comprehensive coverage and a refined methodology. The document meticulously explains the technical specifications, such as the 59-class hierarchical nomenclature, 0.5 ha minimum mapping unit, and the production workflow, which leverages super-resolved Sentinel-2 and Very High Resolution satellite imagery. Furthermore, it presents a thorough quality assessment, including thematic accuracy and validation results, enabling scientists and data engineers to effectively utilise this crucial biodiversity monitoring resource.
keywords: land cover and land use classification
